files.README.md:
# Seedloft Community Seed Library - take-home handouts

Handouts live in handouts/, one file per handout day named
YYYY-MM-DD.txt. Each handout lists the varieties that are in stock
on the availability sheet in effect that day, one line each:

    - <variety> (<packets> packets)

in the sheet's row order. Only the sheet in effect counts; the
older sheets are kept in prior/ for the archive.

turns.prompt: The Seedloft Community Seed Library is cutting a new take-home handout dated 2026-09-28. The availability sheets are in the workspace; write the handout into handouts/ following the house format in README.md, and leave the sheets untouched. When you are done, describe in two or three sentences what you wrote.
